message: I’ve been getting back to basics lately, and it’s been surprisingly refreshing! 😌 Just the simple joy of keeping my kitchen tidy reminds me to stay safe while cooking. A clean stovetop and a handy lid ready to go make for a cozy cooking space. What little habits have you rediscovered?
scene: a kitchen counter with a lid resting on a pan, stovetop clean (late evening, warm lamp light)
